mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate reduces the discount rate applied to equity cash flows, leading to higher valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 4.5% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precedes economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE exceeds 4.5%, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and retail sales (both exceeding 0.5% in the prior month) indicates a broad-based weakening of consumer and business demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline > 0.5% in the prior month
failure_condition: In more than 50% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline by more than 0.5% in the prior month, the 20-day forward returns are positive.

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 2.5%, the Federal Reserve is likely to implement monetary tightening, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL growth rate exceeds 2.5%, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A higher industrial production index (INDPRO) reflects robust manufacturing and industrial activity, which typically supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between INDPRO and 5-day forward returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts rate below 1200 thousand units indicates a contraction in the residential construction sector, which is a leading indicator of weakening consumer demand and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST falls below 1200, the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a strong labor market characterized by monthly job gains exceeding 100,000, consumer spending is robust, supporting corporate revenues and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS growth exceeds 100k per month, the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in quarterly GDP growth and housing starts (both exceeding 0.5% in the last quarter) indicates a broad-based economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and HOUST both decline > 0.5% in the last quarter
failure_condition: When both GDPC1 and HOUST decline by more than 0.5% in the last quarter, the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.
